scripts.build:vercel: rm -rf dist/tazor-relayer/api && esbuild src/vercel.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/tazor-relayer/api/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && cp vercel/vercel.json vercel/package.json dist/tazor-relayer/
scripts.deploy:vercel: pnpm build:vercel && cd dist/tazor-relayer && vercel deploy --prod --yes
